title: stt server request
description: A request file the caller writes as requests/inbox/<request_id>.json (write <request_id>.json.tmp, then rename). Checks the schema cannot express are listed in contracts/README.md section 4 (file name equals request_id, attachment present, language known to the engine, audio length).

request_id.description: Lowercase UUID chosen by the caller; never reused.

requested_by.description: Opaque requester identifier verified by the caller. Used only to compare owners; never logged.

hint.description: One term; no control characters, no leading or trailing whitespace.

file.description: Attachment written next to the request file: <request_id>.audio.<ext>.

from_request.description: Reuse the recording of an earlier transcribe request by the same requester.

language.description: Whisper language code (for example ko). 'auto' is not accepted.

hints.description: Transcription glossary (2), used as engine hints in the given order.

delete_audio.description: after_job: delete the recording right after this job ends. at_midnight: keep it until the next 00:00 Asia/Seoul. Never longer than 24 hours after it was first received.

target.description: request_id of the transcribe request to delete from.

scope.description: result: delete the job's result files only. everything: delete the recording, temporary audio, hint copy and result now.
